state.defect: Reproduced on 8 Nov 2026 with an in-process real engine, journal attached, T0 GPU: publish take T (revision 1), Take it (Taken), then publish T again with an edit while revision 1 is on Program. The second publish is refused PreparationRefused{TransportFailed: 'recovery journal write failed: invalid recovery journal state: program state T/1 is not a published revision'} and the engine sets output_inhibited, so Program stops emitting until ConfigureOutput re-arms it.
state.cause: Engine::publish moves published[T] to revision 2 and then writes the journal. RecoveryState::validate requires program and cued to name the take's currently published revision, and the journal records a prepared scene only for each take's latest published revision. So any state with Program on an older revision of a re-published take is invalid by construction, although the engine itself keeps every published revision prepared in memory (publication is additive, invariant 30) and Playout pins revisions by hash (invariant 61).
state.context: Present since 3.12 and 11.38. Row 5.10 (next after this) makes the Editor publish on every save, so editing a live graphic would black out Program. The worker never re-publishes in conformance while a take is on Program, which is why no test caught it. Rows 3.12 and 11.38 are marked done.

fix_options.journal_referenced_revisions: The journal records a prepared scene for every revision Program or the cue names as well as each take's latest; validate accepts program/cued naming any journaled revision of a published take. Restore rebuilds them all. Schema stays 3 if the shape is unchanged (same PreparedSceneRecord list, more entries).
fix_options.refuse_republish_on_air: Refuse, by name, a publish of a take that is on Program or cued, until it is cleared.
fix_options.skip_journal_check: Relax validate so program/cued may name a revision that is not journaled.

fix.instructions: How should the engine handle a re-publish of a take whose older revision is on Program or cued?

criteria.journal_referenced_revisions: Journal and restore every revision Program or the cue names, as well as the latest; the re-publish succeeds and Program keeps its revision.
criteria.refuse_republish_on_air: Refuse the re-publish by name while the take is on Program or cued.
criteria.skip_journal_check: Relax the journal check; Program may name a revision the journal cannot rebuild.

tracking.instructions: How should the plan track this defect?

criteria.new_row_before_5_10: A new row (Needs 3.12, 5.11), built before 5.10, with a done-when that re-publishes a take on Program on a real worker, keeps Program emitting, and restores both revisions after a kill; 3.12 and 11.38 keep done with a note.
